Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, frontend developers, and product teams to ship impactful features rapidly and iteratively.

Experience: Minimum 2 years in backend development with at least 1 year of hands-on experience working with LLMs or NLP systems.
Programming Skills: Proficient in Python with practical exposure to asynchronous programming and frameworks like FastAPI or Django.

Database Knowledge: Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, including schema design and performance optimization.
Model Engineering: Familiarity with prompt design, LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT), and evaluation metrics for language models.
Cloud Deployment: Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and building serverless or containerized deployments.
NLP Understanding: Solid grasp of NLP concepts including intent detection, dialogue management, and text classification.
Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to translate business problems into AI-first solutions with a user-centric approach.
Team Collaboration: Strong communication skills and a collaborative spirit to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
Curiosity and Drive: Passionate about staying at the forefront of AI and using emerging technologies to build innovative travel experiences.

The Consumer Products Center of Expertise collaborates with Bains global Consumer Products Practice leadership, client-facing Bain leadership and teams, and end clients on the development and delivery of Bain’s proprietary CP products and solutions.

These solutions aim to answer strategic questions relating to brand strategy (consumer needs, assortment, pricing, distribution), revenue growth management (pricing strategy, promotions, profit pools, trade terms), negotiation strategy with key retailers, optimization of COGS, etc.




You will work as part of the team in CP CoE comprising a mix of Directors, Managers, Project Leads, Associates, and Analysts working to implement cloud-based end-to-end advanced analytics solutions.

Delivery models on projects vary from working as part of a CP Center of Expertise, broader global Bain case team within the CP ringfence, or within other industry CoEs such as FS, Retail, TMT, Energy, CME, etc., with BCN on a need basis.




About You

A Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; Bachelor’s candidates with relevant industry experience will also be considered.
4–6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, software development, and building and deploying production AI systems.
Hands-on experience designing agentic AI systems and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or Azure AI Agent Service.
Experience developing LLM-powered applications and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with vector databases and embedding-based retrieval.
Working knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j, Cypher) for knowledge graphs, entity modeling, and graph-based retrieval.

Good to have: Prior exposure to consulting projects or the CP (Consumer Products) business domain.



What You’ll Do

Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems and LLM-powered applications that automate complex analytical and business workflows for Consumer Products clients.

Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and consulting teams to translate business problems into robust, scalable AI solutions.
The Senior Associate is expected to have a knack for seeking out challenging problems and producing their own ideas, which they will be encouraged to brainstorm with their peers and managers.
